apiAlignment: 04A K1 (2026-11-07): one registry for all TransientNotice codes, upper snake case.
description: VideoKit transient notice code registry (04A K1). Kotlin NoticeCodes and Dart NoticeCodes are verified against this file, like errors.json. 'emittedBy' says who sends the code today: KIT (native runtime), DART (Dart Fake / UI), or BOTH. The UI shows known codes with its own text and ignores unknown ones. Codes are upper snake case; new codes are a minor API version change and are appended at the end.

notices.meaning: A seek target was clamped to the media bounds.
The session was degraded because resources were short (decoder not reopened after a visibility release, lower quality).
There is no media in the requested navigation direction.
The image decode resolution was reduced to stay within the image memory budget.
The audio track cannot be decoded; the picture plays silently.
Another app took the system audio focus for good; playback paused (not muted). Transient losses follow the platform default and send no notice.

exportWarningsDescription: Export warning codes (04A K3) in ExportResult.warnings and the export precheck. On the wire a warning is the code alone or CODE:argument when argument names what the warning is about (for example the mask id). Kotlin ExportWarnings and Dart ExportWarnings are verified against this group.

exportWarnings.meaning: A fast concatenation boundary was moved to the nearest key frame.
Silence was inserted for an input without audio.
The tracking of a mask did not complete.
The user accepted uncovered tracking ranges; the mask does not cover them.
The tracking of a mask has lost ranges that were not accepted.
Demo backend: no real media file was produced.
The engine refused fast (remux) concatenation; the export transcodes instead.
